summary: All fixer and explorer subagent spawns failed at session start with 'Session too large to compact - context exceeds model limit even after stripping media', including a one-line probe prompt. Implementer spawns succeed (PROBE-OK).
root_cause: Oversized fixed context (agent system prompt + skill index) for fixer/explorer agent types exceeds the model context limit before any task content is added. Recurrence of open NCR-2026-09-28-SUBAGENT-COMPACTION-001, now affecting fixer and explorer, not just librarian.
what_i_did_wrong: Dispatched all three lanes to fixer in parallel without first probing spawn viability, losing a full round-trip. Should have probed one lane before fanning out after the known open compaction NCR.
remediation: Re-dispatch the three benchmark lanes to implementer (which spawns successfully; also the role ROLE-MATRIX prescribes for feature/broad implementation work). Record recurrence against NCR-2026-09-28-SUBAGENT-COMPACTION-001.
